eps.d: Doctor Gloom and General Blight plan to take over the world as soon as they have disposed of Bananaman. As Bananaman tries to stop them he is turned into a baby by Doctor Gloom's ray gun.
With the help of underground criminal The Mole, the Heavy Mob break out of jail and escape through an underground tunnel. Bananaman follows in order to dispose of the Mole and capture the Heavy Mob.
Bananaman must stop The Weatherman from ruining England's nice day with his weather machine.
King Zorg and his army of Nerks transport Bananaman to their home planet to give him the locations of all the military installations and Chinese takeaways.
General Blight kidnaps the chairman of the United Nations Christmas Club committee and chains him to a railway track, demanding billions of pounds of ransom money.
Everybody thinks that the house on Hangman's Hill is haunted by a ghost. Bananaman is sent to investigate.
When aliens attack - Bananaman springs to the rescue!
A mysterious storm has struck - can Bananaman save the day?
Bananaman has a day off, but General Blight has other ideas...
Bananaman has a new assistant, but will he be up to the challenge?
General Blight's hit-lady sets her sights on Bananaman...again!
General Blight and Doctor Gloom are up to no good at the funfair, and it's up to Bananaman to stop them!
Bananaman gets into a sticky situation deep underground...
Bananaman drops in on the mysterious jungles of the Banana Republic.
Stupid, but well-meaning and super-strong superhero, Bananaman gets his strength from eating bananas.
Bananaman comes face to face with Doctor Gloom's latest creation!
General Blight has a plan to steal some priceless antiques...can Bananaman stop him?
Bananaman is patrolling for those devious villains, the Heavy Mob!
Weatherman is back, and Bananaman hasn't the foggiest!
There's been a hijacking - can Bananaman track down the culprit?
Dr Gloom has invented a cloning machine, and it's up to Bananaman to stop it!
There's a problem at the banana plantations, and that's bad news for the Man of Peel!
Bananaman travels to the Planet Nerk to compete in King Zorg's Olympics!
The Nerks have another plan to attack Earth - can Bananaman stop them?
Dr Gloom and General Blight are at it again. This time around sees Crow being captured and a ship of bananas fearing its doom.
The Nerks have invaded Earth, and it's down to Bananaman to stop them!
Bananaman gets put on ice by the Weatherman's latest creation.
Dr Gloom takes over the TV and forces the newsreader to tell the world not to help ladies cross the road, not to brush their teeth and (gasp) not to eat bananas.
Dr Gloom teams up with a weatherman to try and cause mayhem, without counting on the presence of our banana hero.
Bananaman ends up in shark-infested waters, but can he escape General Blight's clutches?
Dr Gloom discovers a way for General Blight to sabotage and perhaps once and for all destroy Bananaman by making him invisible.
Bananaman beats the Heavy Mob at their own game... cricket!
Bananaman must fight the evil villains to rescue Ping Pong the ape.
Bananaman enters the Great Air Race - can he beat the competition?
Bananaman scales a mountain and makes a chilling discovery.
Bananaman goes to the circus, but will General Blight stop clowning around?
A cargo train with bananas is at risk from the Heavy Mob.
The Heavy Mob have a plan to steal the Crown Jewels - Bananaman to the rescue!
General Blight has given out his orders, things don't look good for the Man of Peel!
